design_notes: Serif throughout, hairline rules, single accent colour; no icons or decorative imagery.
Render the financials table with FY2018 as the rightmost column and a heavier rule above the totals row.
The pull-quote sits on the accent colour with a hairline rule above and below; no quotation-mark ornament.
The industry snapshot stat strip runs full measure between paragraphs, three columns, no borders.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue is 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value each, at a price the filing still shows as [●] [^drhp-p29]. The objects list ₹1,130 lakhs (₹11.30 crore) toward working capital and an undetermined amount toward general corporate purposes — uses that fit a fresh issue, though the fresh/offer-for-sale split is not disclosed [^drhp-p48]. Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited is lead manager; Bigshare Services Private Limited is registrar [^drhp-p31].
sidebars.rationale: Pulls the offer mechanics into one scannable block so the reader can see what is fixed and what is still blank.
